newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SUDZUKER WANTS TO INVEST INTO SUGAR INDUSTRY.
newsitem.headline: SUDZUKER WANTS TO INVEST INTO SUGAR INDUSTRY.

text.p: German food industry concern Sudzuker AG would like to invest in Lithuania's sugar industry, the government's press office said on Thursday.

"The concern has analysed in detail the restructuring possibilities of Lithuania's four sugar refineries, where Sudzuker AG would like to have a control share portfolio," the government's press office said in a statement.
The statement said that the government applauded the initiative of the concern to invest in the country's sugar industry.

"The attraction of big foreign investments and the restructuring of the sugar factories will have a positive influence on the country's economy," the statement quoted Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius as saying.
"It would also make negotiations with the EU over the volumes of sugar produced easier," the statement added.
Vagnorius met representatives of Sudzuker AG on Thursday.
